sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def state():
    seg=current_frame.segmentation
    b=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    greens=[]
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N' and n['pixels']>=8:
            r0,c0=n['boundary'][0]; r1,c1=n['boundary'][2]
            greens.append(((r0+r1)//2,(c0+c1)//2, b[(r0+r1)//2][(c0+c1)//2]))
    return greens
print('before', state())
r=action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':31,'col':31}]); print('selected right green', state())
r=action(['LEFT']); print('after LEFT1', state(), 'changed', r['board_changed'])
r=action(['LEFT']); print('after LEFT2', state(), 'changed', r['board_changed'])
r=action(['LEFT']); print('after LEFT3', state(), 'changed', r['board_changed'])
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
